Rachel — looping you in on the Acme Health opportunity. AWS PDM Sean O'Connell is the point for ACE commercialization guidance and to help move the co-sell motion forward. Quick context: Acme is evaluating a dedicated inference offering and is excited about Redwood for latency/cost predictability; they'd like to pursue ACE registration to enable co-sell.

High level asks:
- Confirm who from our side should own ACE intake and the marketplace listing artifact.
- Attach the MOP and ACE checklist we've used before (I'll share after you confirm).

Sean — meet Rachel (Sales Ops / Deals). Rachel will coordinate internal artifacts + PSM intro. Kimberly (cc) will own marketplace listing assets.

Thanks —

Quick answers:
- Kimberly will own the marketplace assets and the listing submission.
- I will drive ACE intake and the mutual action plan for the co-sell.

Sean: can you confirm the PDM/PSM cadence you prefer for ACE deals (intro, weekly sync cadence during intake, required ops owners)? Acme's timeline is fairly tight — they want ACE registration + marketplace listing in parallel and hope to start a pilot in mid-December.

I've attached our ACE checklist and a draft MOP (minimal operating plan). If you also have a single-sheet for ACE readiness that AWS prefers, please share so we align formats.

1) PDM/PSM intro call next week — 30 minutes to align responsibilities and timeline.
2) Share a short MOP with milestones (we've added tentative dates in the draft).
3) Kimberly to gather listing artifacts (logos, support contact, technical summary).

Hi Rachel / Aditya — great to meet you both. Marta (Acme) — nice to e-meet.

Thanks for the materials, Rachel. Our typical flow for ACE + marketplace co-sell:
- Intro call (PDM + PSM + seller) to agree on mutual action plan and success metrics.
- AWS Marketplace intake runs parallel to ACE registration; Marketplace team needs the listing assets and 30-day lead time for approvals.
- We require a short pilot plan (3–6 weeks) and a security/governance brief for customers in healthcare.

I attached the AWS intake template and a short ACE readiness checklist we use on our side.

Questions / asks:
1) Can Redwood commit to a pilot window of Dec 13–31? That helps AWS classify the opportunity for co-sell prioritization.
2) Can Kimberly share the current listing draft (logo, support, product blurb) by EOD Monday?
3) We need a named PSM from Acme (or a technical lead) for the pilot; Marta, can you confirm?

I'll propose Wed 11/10 10:00 AM PT for the 30-min intro (PDM/PSM + Redwood + Acme). If that works I'll send a calendar invite and include the Marketplace intake contact.

Sean O'Connell
Partner Development Manager, AWS
sean.oconnell@amazon.com
[attachment: AWS_ACE_intake_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

- Kimberly will send the listing draft (logos, 200-word blurb, support contact) by EOD Monday 11/9.
- Redwood confirms pilot window Dec 13–31 (we'll reserve Dedicated capacity for that period).
- I'll collect Acme's named PSM/tech lead; Marta, could you confirm by Monday?
- I'll take ownership of the mutual action plan (MOP_template.xlsx) and will populate milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria by Monday evening.

Proposed MOP milestones (we'll refine on the intro call):
- 11/9: Marketplace assets delivered to AWS marketplace contact
- 11/10: PDM/PSM intro call (30 min)
- 11/12: ACE intake submission
- 11/20: ACE registration approval (target)
- 12/13: Pilot start (pilot verification checklist completed)

Marta — appreciate your support confirming the PSM and any compliance constraints for Acme's pilot.

I'll send the calendar invite for 11/10 10:00 AM PT once Sean confirms.

Best,
